success.content:
# Product page: Trail Runner 2

A product page for our new trail running shoe, Trail Runner 2, on the Stride online store. The store is already a React app with a homepage that links to `/products/trail-runner-2`; build the product page at that address, using mock data, and don't add any packages to the app beyond React and its build tool. For the look, you can take inspiration from this design:

![Trail Runner 2 product page](design.jpg)

- **Store:** the shopper sees the store name and how many items are in their cart.
- **Menu:** the shopper can go to the store's main sections, such as men, women and kids, from the top of the page.
- **Path:** the shopper sees where the shoe sits in the store, such as Shop, Trail, Trail Runner 2, and can go back to any earlier step.
- **Photos:** the shopper sees one photo of the shoe at a time and moves to the next or previous one, going back to the first after the last.
- **Price:** the shopper sees the price and can point at a small "i" next to it to learn that it includes taxes.
- **Color:** the shopper can choose blue, black or grey; only the chosen color shows until they change it, each with a round swatch.
- **Size:** the shopper picks one size from a list that only opens when they want to change it; only the chosen size shows, and sold-out sizes can't be picked.
- **Size guide:** the shopper can open a size chart over the page from next to the size, enter their foot length and choose US or EU to get their size, and must close it to continue.
- **Quantity:** the shopper can choose how many pairs to buy, typing the number or changing it by one.
- **Add to cart:** the shopper adds the shoe to the cart and sees a confirmation; without a size they are asked to pick one.
- **Wishlist:** the shopper can save or unsave the shoe with a heart.
- **More information:** details, reviews and shipping sit side by side below everything, with one section shown at a time.
- **Questions:** a few common questions about the shoe, each with its answer hidden until the shopper opens it.
- **Bottom of the page:** the shopper finds customer help, company and social media links.

success.diffString:
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/browsertest/check.js
@@ -1,0 +1,122 @@
+const { chromium } = require('playwright')
+
+const results = []
+const errors = []
+
+function check(name, ok, extra = '') {
+  results.push(`${ok ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'} ${name}${extra ? ` — ${extra}` : ''}`)
+}
+
+;(async () => {
+  const browser = await chromium.launch()
+  const page = await browser.newPage()
+  page.on('pageerror', (e) => errors.push(`pageerror: ${e.message}`))
+  page.on('console', (m) => {
+    if (m.type() === 'error') errors.push(`console: ${m.text()}`)
+  })
+
+  await page.goto('http://localhost:4173/products/trail-runner-2', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
+
+  // Page renders
+  check('h1 shows product name', (await page.locator('h1').textContent()) === 'Trail Runner 2')
+
+  // Header: store name + cart count
+  check('store name visible', await page.locator('.logo', { hasText: 'Stride' }).isVisible())
+  check('cart starts at 0', (await page.locator('.cart-count').textContent()) === '0')
+
+  // Menu
+  const nav = page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Main sections' })
+  check('menu has Men/Women/Kids',
+    (await nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Men' }).count()) === 1 &&
+    (await nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Women' }).count()) === 1 &&
+    (await nav.getByRole('link', { name: 'Kids' }).count()) === 1)
+
+  // Breadcrumbs
+  const crumbs = page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Breadcrumb' })
+  check('breadcrumb trail', (await crumbs.textContent()).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').includes('Shop › Trail › Trail Runner 2'))
+  check('breadcrumb current page', (await crumbs.locator('[aria-current="page"]').textContent()) === 'Trail Runner 2')
+
+  // Gallery carousel with wrap-around
+  const status = page.locator('.gallery-status')
+  check('gallery starts 1 of 3', (await status.textContent()) === '1 of 3')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next photo' }).click()
+  check('next photo -> 2 of 3', (await status.textContent()) === '2 of 3')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous photo' }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Previous photo' }).click()
+  check('wraps to last: 3 of 3', (await status.textContent()) === '3 of 3')
+
+  // Price + tooltip
+  check('price shown', (await page.locator('.price-amount').textContent()) === '$129.99')
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Price information' }).focus()
+  check('tax tooltip on focus', await page.locator('#price-tip').isVisible())
+
+  // Colors: radio swatches
+  const black = page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'Black' })
+  await black.check()
+  check('black color selected', await black.isChecked())
+  check('legend shows chosen color', (await page.locator('.colors legend').textContent()).includes('Black'))
+
+  // Size select: sold-out disabled
+  const select = page.locator('select')
+  const soldOut = await page.locator('select option[disabled]').count()
+  check('sold-out sizes disabled', soldOut === 2, `${soldOut} disabled`)
+
+  // Add to cart without size -> error
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
+  const alert = page.getByRole('alert')
+  check('size required error', (await alert.textContent()).includes('select a size'))
+
+  // Pick size, set quantity, add
+  await select.selectOption({ label: 'US 9 / EU 42.5' })
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Increase quantity' }).click()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add to cart' }).click()
+  check('cart count updated to 2', (await page.locator('.cart-count').textContent()) === '2')
+  check('confirmation shown', (await page.getByRole('status').last().textContent()).includes('Added 2'))
+
+  // Wishlist toggle
+  const wish = page.getByRole('button', { name: /wishlist/i })
+  await wish.click()
+  check('wishlist pressed', (await wish.getAttribute('aria-pressed')) === 'true')
+
+  // Size guide modal
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Size guide' }).click()
+  const dialog = page.getByRole('dialog')
+  check('modal opens', await dialog.isVisible())
+  check('focus trapped in modal', await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.closest('[role="dialog"]') !== null))
+  await page.locator('#foot-length').fill('27')
+  await page.getByRole('radio', { name: 'EU' }).check()
+  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Find my size' }).click()
+  check('size suggestion', (await dialog.locator('.size-result').textContent()).includes('EU 42'))
+  await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+  check('modal closes on Escape', (await page.getByRole('dialog').count()) === 0)
+  check('focus returns to trigger', await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement.textContent === 'Size guide'))
+
+  // Tabs
+  await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Reviews' }).click()
+  check('reviews tab shown', (await page.getByRole('tabpanel').textContent()).includes('Maya R.'))
+  await page.keyboard.press('ArrowRight')
+  check('arrow key moves tab', (await page.getByRole('tab', { name: 'Shipping' }).getAttribute('aria-selected')) === 'true')
+
+  // FAQ accordion
+  const q = page.getByRole('button', { name: /waterproof/i })
+  await q.click()
+  check('faq expands', (await q.getAttribute('aria-expanded')) === 'true')
+  check('faq answer visible', await page.locator('#faq-panel-0').isVisible())
+
+  // Footer
+  check('footer help nav', (await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Customer help' }).count()) === 1)
+  check('footer social nav', (await page.getByRole('navigation', { name: 'Social media' }).count()) === 1)
+
+  // Homepage link still works
+  await page.goto('http://localhost:4173/', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' })
+  check('homepage renders', (await page.locator('h1').textContent()) === 'Stride')
+
+  console.log(results.join('\n'))
+  console.log(errors.length ? `\nJS ERRORS:\n${errors.join('\n')}` : '\nNo JS errors.')
+  const failed = results.filter((r) => r.startsWith('FAIL')).length
+  await browser.close()
+  process.exit(failed || errors.length ? 1 : 0)
+})().catch((e) => {
+  console.error(e)
+  process.exit(1)
+})
